title: kb-sprint run step 2 and the Self-check checkout line name the move to a linked worktree before the first claim
goal: The kb-sprint skill's run step 2 names how an orchestrator that finds another session's files in its checkout moves (git worktree add of its own worktree before its first claim, workers' worktrees under either checkout accepted by land), and the Self-check checkout line no longer tells it to use a standalone clone only.

run: import sys;t=open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();l=[x for x in t.split(chr(10)) if x.strip().startswith('2. `git status --short`')][0];c=[x for x in t.split(chr(10)) if x.startswith('- `checkout`')][0];ok='git worktree add' in l and 'first claim' in l and 'use a standalone' not in c;print('run step 2 names the worktree move and the checkout line is updated:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
